svg.title: How to play, page 1 of 2 - setup and Week 1 (A4 portrait)
svg.desc: A4 quick reference, page 1 of 2. Setup, then Week 1 - deliberately almost trivial: lay five cards, resolve them, close the week. Page 2 (leaflet-how-to-play-2-A4-portrait) covers weeks after that and how the project ends. Black and white line art for cheap office printing; styling comes later.
svg.text: HOW TO PLAY
Seven weeks. Five days a week, for the whole team. Six features. One deadline that does not move.
PAGE 1 OF 2 · SETUP AND WEEK 1
SETTING UP
about fifteen minutes, and the first part is the best part
Deal each player five habitus parts at random and assemble the figure onto the Specimen board.
Take the matching NEED tile (your Torso) and HERO tile (your Head), and slot those too.
Turn over board THE ZONE. Place your figure's tile on the grid: your Legs' row × your Item's column.
Read the row/column rule and what Learn/Teach do in one line each - no detail needed yet.
Pick one PROJECT card. Turn over board 1 to THE PROJECT side and seat it - it names features A - F.
Read the project and its six features together - complexity, LOCK tiles across D and F, what unlocks what.
Go through the Activity cards that come out now: Work, Coordinate, Celebrate. The rest wait for later weeks.
FINISH THE ROOM
Only THE PROJECT and THE ZONE start face up. REALITY and THE TEAM stay text side up;
THE PAYOFF and STANDING stay boxed.
Motivation 3 for every character. Week marker on Week 1. Shuffle the Events but don't draw yet.
Everything on the covered boards already sits at 2. It just isn't your problem for a few more weeks.
WEEK 1
deliberately almost trivial - lay five cards, resolve them, close the week
Only THE PROJECT and THE ZONE are face up. Shit Happens, Adapt and the Ledger wait for week 2;
the Specimen panel on your person board isn't read until week 3.
1 · PLAN THE WEEK
Lay five Activity cards across Monday to Friday. Put a character disc on each - that person's Skill,
Knowledge and Capital apply to that day. One person may take several days, or none. A slot may instead
take a Flex marker, giving back a day someone worked as Overtime. Then stop. Nothing has resolved.
2 · THE WEEK RUNS
Resolve all five cards. Order does not matter - the week happened at once, not one day at a time.
3 · CLOSE THE WEEK
Bank any feature that finished (lift its lock, if any, and pay Capital). Everyone then loses 1 Motivation -
the weekly grind. Nobody empties out on week 1 alone, so there is nothing else to check yet.
Move the week marker one step closer to the deadline. That's the whole week - three steps, no exceptions.
bank before the grind - it's the only spend this week.
FROM WEEK 2
Board 3 turns face up: the Ledger - Trust, Capability, Shared Practice, Adaptability - starts being read
at Close the Week. Nothing else about a week changes yet.
A week is five days, and you choose them. That's the entire idea, before anything else gets added to it.
FLIP THIS SHEET WHEN WEEK 1 CLOSES → WEEK 2 ON IS ON THE BACK
